title: Launch countdowns stop at 10-15 seconds with craft seen

tellings.quote: get down to 10 or 15 seconds and it stops then everything's normal again crazy and people rolling up on these sites have sometimes seen those crafts and they blow away

plain: At nuclear missile sites near Ellsworth in South Dakota in the 1970s, launch countdowns are said to have started on their own, run down to 10 or 15 seconds, then stopped, with everything going back to normal. Mario Woods, a former nuclear missile guard, says that people rushing to these sites sometimes saw strange craft that then flew off at great speed. If true, it would mean something unknown was able to reach into America's nuclear weapons.
